pricing_formula: round(base_rub * colour_multiplier) + installation_addition_rub + connection_addition_rub; then convert to BYN and apply series markup
availability_scope: Factory calculator for every depth/section combination in XML, one real article per combination; published technical limits are by series, depth, sections and mounting. Other mountings and geometries outside these ranges are not invented.
